sentences.text: ON THE 22nd OF DECEMBER, 2025  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 58272 of 2025  DHARMENDRA  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS

Appearance:
 Ms. Mansi Kushwah, counsel for the applicant.
 Mr. Romil Verma, counsel for the non-applicant/State.
ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

(2) Applicant has filed the first bail application under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/ Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, as he is implicated in connection with Crime No.210/2024 registered at Police Station - Bilpank, District - Ratlam (MP) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(N), 376(3) of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 4(2),
5(L), 5(J)(2) and 6 of Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The applicant is behind the bars since 12.01.2025.

(3) Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 183 of BNS has stated that she has taken the education up-to 09th Standard and she has solemnized the marriage with the accused and has a child out of their wedlock.
She further submits that she was 18 years of age on the date of incident i.e. on 02.02.2024.
The prosecutrix submits that she has solemnized the marriage with the prosecutrix on her own volition and has one daughter out of their marriage who was born on 10.10.2024.
It is a clear case of consent and the prosecutrix was major at the time of solemnization of marriage.

The applicant is behind NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:37665 2 MCRC-58272-2025 the bars since 12.01.2025 and the conclusion of trial will take sufficiently long time.
Thus, it is prayed that applicant may be enlarged on bail.
( 4 ) Per contra, counsel for the non-applicant/State has opposed the bail application and prays for its rejection.

(5) Having considered the rival submissions and on perusal of the case- diary as well as the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 183 of BNS, this Court is inclined to allow the Dharmendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40838765/
1 present application.

entities.text: Dharmendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (6) Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is hereby allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.

(7) Accordingly, the bail application is allowed and disposed of,
in aforesaid terms.

(PAVAN KUMAR DWIVEDI) VACATION JUDGE Arun/-
